chapter: New York, Philadelphia and Harlem nightlife
title: The Jerusalem misunderstanding again
summary: He returns to his belief that Jerusalem and Bethlehem were in heaven as an example of unseen realities.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: And it's just like that thing about...did I tell you about "Going to Jerusalem?"
Yes, yeah, we talked about that.

Same thing. So many of the things with which we are confronted in life are not real. They are real, but we don't see them as being real. Can you imagine me thinking 'til I was thirty that "walking Jerusalem." I thought I had to be in heaven. I thought when he said, "Go to Jerusalem" he meant that, oh boy, you know what I mean, I'm going to die and the casket'll be pink and, you know, and I'll... and all that business. And then Bethlehem. I thought Bethlehem was in heaven. And then don't worry, Dan, millions of people over the years, if they don't know better now, felt the same way. And it's the same way about anything else.
